name: Christian Education
overview: Christian education is rooted in the reverent fear of the Lord, which is the foundation of true knowledge and wisdom, as Proverbs 1:7 teaches. It involves purposeful training and guidance, especially of children, to follow God's ways, ensuring they remain steadfast in faith throughout life, as emphasized in Proverbs 22:6. Ephesians 6:4 further instructs fathers to nurture and admonish their children in the Lord without provoking them, highlighting the importance of a loving and godly approach to spiritual instruction.
